text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 31, 2024) for 90 Eastdale Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 31, 2024) for 90 Eastdale Avenue, Folder Number 24 232940 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
